title: 第536章 我选择你死第535章 激战金乌太子
slug: 我纨绔世子开局征服太子妃
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：我，纨绔世子，开局征服太子妃！第一卷：默认第536章我选择，你死！（..la）轰隆！
剑光与那颗金色的“太阳”，在半空中轰然相撞。
整个空间，都在这一刻，剧烈地颤抖起来，仿佛随时都会崩塌。
一道肉眼可见的冲击波，朝着四面八方席卷开来，将无数观战的天骄，都掀飞了出去。
噗！
楚风如遭雷击，身体不受控制地倒飞而出，在半空中喷出一大口金色的血液，脸色瞬间变得苍白。
而另一边，那巨大的三足金乌，同样发出一声凄厉的悲鸣。
他那庞大的身躯，被剑光从中间劈开了一道深可见骨的伤口，金色的血液如同暴雨般洒落。
两败俱伤！
“小风！”
“楚风！”
诸葛玥和月婵仙子见状，花容失色，连忙冲了过去，一左一右地扶住了摇摇欲坠的楚风。
整个战场，陷入了一片死寂。
所有人都被这场惊世骇俗的大战，给彻底震慑住了。
一个圣君境一重，一个战力堪比圣皇。
这两人，竟然打了个平分秋色？
这人皇传人，到底是个什么怪物？！
“不愧是人皇传人，果然强悍。”
就在此时，一道平静的声音响起。
那名身负重瞳的石毅，缓缓从人群中走出，他那双奇特的眸子深深地看了一眼楚风，又扫了一眼远处同样身受重伤，重新化为人形的金乌太子。

“不过，你一个人，是挡不住我们这么多人的。”石毅的语气很平淡，像是在陈述一个事实，“这传承，你保不住。我劝你，还是尽快离开吧。”
他这话，看似是在劝说，实则也是一种警告。
楚风心中冷笑，这石毅倒是打得一手好算盘。
如今他和金乌太子两败俱伤，正是这群人坐收渔翁之利的好时机。
对方现在站出来说这番话，无非是想兵不血刃地将他逼走，然后他们再慢慢争夺这传承。
“呵呵，真是精彩，真是精彩啊。”
就在楚风准备开口的时候，一阵突兀的掌声，从不远处传来。
众人循声望去，只见神庭神子神无道，不知何时已经出现在了那里。
他脸上带着一丝玩味的笑容，目光饶有兴致地在楚风和金乌太子身上来回扫视。
“人皇传人，你的确有点本事，没让本神子失望。”神无道注视着楚风，语气中带着一种高高在上的审视，“不过，你若就这点本事，那想做本神子的对手，还差得远呢。”
他这话，狂傲到了极点，根本没把刚才打出圣皇之威的金乌太子放在眼里。
金乌太子脸色铁青，却罕见地没有反驳。
因为他知道，神无道，有这个狂傲的资本。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: I, the dandy prince, conquer the crown princess at the beginning! Volume 1: Default Chapter 536 I choose, you die! (..la) Boom!
The sword light and the golden "sun" collided in mid-air.
The entire space was shaking violently at this moment, as if it would collapse at any time.
A shock wave visible to the naked eye swept in all directions, flying away countless geniuses who were watching the battle.
puff!
As if Chu Feng was struck by lightning, his body flew out uncontrollably, spurting out a large mouthful of golden blood in mid-air, and his face instantly turned pale.
On the other side, the huge three-legged Golden Crow also let out a shrill scream.
His huge body was split open in the middle by the sword light with a bone-deep wound, and golden blood spilled like a torrential rain.
Both sides suffer!
"Xiao Feng!"
"Chu Feng!"
When Zhuge Yue and Fairy Yuechan saw this, their beautiful faces turned pale. They rushed over and supported Chu Feng, who was on the verge of collapse.
The entire battlefield fell into a dead silence.
Everyone was completely shocked by this shocking battle.
One is at the first level of the Saint King Realm, and the other has combat power comparable to that of the Saint Emperor.
These two people actually fought evenly?
What kind of monster is this descendant of the Human Emperor? !
"As expected of the successor of the Human Emperor, he is indeed strong."
At this moment, a calm voice sounded.
The man with heavy eyes, Shi Yi, slowly walked out of the crowd. His strange eyes took a deep look at Chu Feng, and then glanced at the Golden Crow Prince in the distance who was also seriously injured and transformed into a human again.
"However, you alone cannot stop so many of us." Shi Yi's tone was very calm, as if he was stating a fact, "You can't keep this inheritance. I advise you to leave as soon as possible."
His words seemed to be persuading, but in fact they were also a warning.
Chu Feng sneered in his heart, Shi Yi was really good at planning.
Now that both he and the Golden Crow Prince are hurt, it is a good time for these people to reap the benefits.
The other party is now standing up and saying this, just to force him away without any blood, and then they will slowly fight for this inheritance.
"Haha, it's really wonderful, it's really wonderful."
Just when Chu Feng was about to speak, a burst of sudden applause came from not far away.
Everyone followed the sound and saw Shen Wudao, the son of Shenting, appearing there at some unknown time.
There was a playful smile on his face, and his eyes glanced back and forth at Chu Feng and the Golden Crow Crown Prince with great interest.
"Heir of the Human Emperor, you do have some skills and you have not disappointed this Son of God." Shen Wudao looked at Chu Feng with a condescending look in his tone, "However, if you only have this ability, you are still far from being a match for this Son of God."
His words were extremely arrogant, and he didn't even take the Golden Crow Crown Prince who had just displayed the power of the Holy Emperor into his eyes.
Prince Jinwu's face was ashen, but he rarely retorted.
Because he knows that Shen Wudao has this arrogant capital.
